observations.note: Hunton Andrews Kurth's insurance-recovery lawyers, 28 May 2025; dated at the post, since it reports the exclusion as the most recent.
observations.raw_snippet: Most recently, one insurer, Berkley, has introduced the first so-called “Absolute” AI exclusion in several specialty lines of liability coverage
observations.subject: insurer_ai_exclusions
observations.value_text: Berkley introduces an "absolute" AI exclusion for its D&O, E&O and fiduciary liability products (May 2025)

observations.note: TechCrunch relaying the Financial Times; AIG, also named by the FT, told TechCrunch it has no plans to use the exclusions, so it is not counted.
observations.raw_snippet: Major insurers including Great American, Chubb, and W. R. Berkley are asking U.S. regulators for permission to exclude widespread AI-related liabilities from corporate policies.
observations.subject: insurer_ai_exclusions
observations.value_text: Great American, Chubb and W. R. Berkley ask US regulators to let them exclude AI liabilities from corporate policies (Nov 2025)

observations.note: Verisk's ISO forms CG 40 47, CG 40 48 and CG 35 08, edition date January 2026; optional, so each insurer chooses whether to attach them.
observations.raw_snippet: Verisk’s ISO Core Lines and Emerging Issues teams developed new general liability endorsements that allow carriers to exclude generative AI exposures.
observations.subject: insurer_ai_exclusions
observations.value_text: ISO's generative-AI exclusion endorsements for general liability take effect (January 2026)

observations.note: Chaucer press release, published 10 Feb 2026, quoting Armilla's chief executive. Counted as `for` because the carrier's own cyber and tech E&O policy stops being where AI-model losses sit; the AI part is a standalone policy backed by Lloyd's.
observations.raw_snippet: AI liability is rapidly moving from an implicit exposure within cyber and technology policies to a risk that demands dedicated coverage.
observations.subject: insurer_ai_exclusions
observations.value_text: Chaucer and Armilla launch Vanguard AI, moving AI-model losses out of Chaucer's cyber and tech E&O cover into a separate AI policy (Feb 2026)

observations.note: Claims Journal, 20 Jul 2026, quoting an attorney who practises in the cyber space.
observations.raw_snippet: She has seen carriers increasingly submit filings with state insurance regulators to be able to use three ISO endorsements.
observations.subject: insurer_ai_exclusions
observations.value_text: An insurance lawyer reports carriers increasingly filing to use ISO's generative-AI exclusions (Jul 2026)
